notes: Taxis (Careem/Uber) are the main way to get around; buses with a Hafilat card are cheap. The E100 bus to Dubai takes 1.5 hours (25 AED). The airport is 30 minutes away.
From November to March it is a perfect 22-28°C. December brings the Yas F1 race (hotels fill up), January and February suit the beach; visit the mosque at sunset.
The mosque is free (registration and abaya), Louvre 63, Qasr 65, Ferrari 345, safari 250-350. Tip 10%; alcohol is served only in hotels and licensed venues.
Dress: shoulders and knees covered in malls and the mosque. The mosque is closed on Friday midday and the Louvre on Monday; Ferrari World is cheaper booked online as a combo.
Turkish citizens can stay 90 days without a visa; cards are accepted everywhere; the weekend is Friday and Saturday.
Emirati food to try: machboos, harees, luqaimat and camel milk. Good places: Al Fanar, Meylas, Al Mrzab and Erth.

days.theme: Grand Mosque and Qasr Al Watan

stops.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
stops.tips: A white marble mosque with 82 domes and the world's largest carpet. Free entry, online registration, abayas provided. Closed Friday midday; magical at sunset.

stops.name: Wahat Al Karama
stops.tips: Martyrs' memorial of aluminium panels, with the mosque reflected in it.

stops.name: Qasr Al Watan
stops.tips: The presidential palace: the Great Hall dome, the library and an evening light show (Palace in Motion).

stops.name: Emirates Palace Le Café
stops.tips: Gold-leaf cappuccino and camel milk with dates at the 'palace' hotel.

stops.name: Corniche
stops.tips: 8 km of waterfront: a sunset walk, the beach (flagged area 10 AED) and cycling.

backups.name: Al Mrzab Emirati
backups.tips: Bib Gourmand Emirati restaurant; try machboos (spiced rice with meat) and luqaimat (sweet dumplings).

backups.name: Founder's Memorial
backups.tips: A 3D portrait of Sheikh Zayed (Constellation), lit up at night. An alternative to the Corniche.

stops.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
stops.tips: Jean Nouvel's 'rain of light' dome and a universal museum, with Da Vinci's La Belle Ferronnière. Closed Monday; book online. Boat tour costs extra.

stops.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi Café
stops.tips: A waterside café under the dome.

stops.name: Abrahamic Family House
stops.tips: A mosque, church and synagogue side by side. Free, with registration.

stops.name: Saadiyat Beach Club
stops.tips: A protected white-sand beach with turtle nesting sites and sunsets. Entry 150 (weekdays).

backups.name: Fouquet's Abu Dhabi
backups.tips: A French brasserie inside the Louvre, with views of the dome.

backups.name: Soul Beach Saadiyat
backups.tips: A public beach; a cheaper option than the beach club.

stops.name: Ferrari World Abu Dhabi
stops.tips: Home to Formula Rossa, the world's fastest roller coaster (240 km/h). Indoor and air-conditioned; book online (Yas 2-park combo).

stops.name: Yas Mall Food Court
stops.tips: A lunch break; return with your park ticket (until 16:00).

stops.name: Yas Marina Circuit
stops.tips: The F1 track: free cycling and walking in the evening, Tuesday to Sunday. Yas Viceroy hotel alongside.

stops.name: Yas Bay Waterfront
stops.tips: Waterside restaurants and Etihad Arena; come in the evening.

backups.name: Warner Bros World
backups.tips: An indoor cartoon theme park; an alternative to Ferrari World (with children).

backups.name: Cipriani Yas Island
backups.tips: Italian restaurant above the marina; a smarter option than Yas Bay.

stops.name: Al Ain Oasis
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed oasis with 147,000 date palms and falaj irrigation channels. 1.5 hours by car or bus; shaded paths.

stops.name: Al Jahili Fort
stops.tips: An 1891 fort with a Wilfred Thesiger photography exhibition. Free entry.

stops.name: Al Ain Palace Museum
stops.tips: Sheikh Zayed's former palace; explore the rooms.

stops.name: Al Fanar Al Ain
stops.tips: 1960s Emirati décor; try machboos and harees (slow-cooked wheat and meat porridge).

stops.name: Jebel Hafeet
stops.tips: A 1,240 m mountain road, among the world's best driving roads. Sunset at the summit, with views over the desert and Oman.

backups.name: Al Ain Camel Market
backups.tips: A camel market, lively in the morning. An alternative to the palace.

backups.name: Mercure Jebel Hafeet Café
backups.tips: A hilltop hotel terrace for tea and views.

stops.name: Eastern Mangroves Kayak
stops.tips: Canoe through the mangrove forest in the city, spotting flamingos and herons. Cool in the morning.

stops.name: Qasr Al Hosn
stops.tips: Abu Dhabi's oldest building (1795 tower), telling the city's history. Next to the Cultural Foundation.

stops.name: Al Mina Fish Market Lunch
stops.tips: A harbour market: pick your fish and have it cooked at the restaurant next door.

stops.name: Desert Safari Al Khatim
stops.tips: Dune bashing (4x4), camel rides and sandboarding, then sunset and camp.

stops.name: Desert Camp Dinner
stops.tips: BBQ buffet, shisha, henna and tanoura dancing. Included in the tour.

backups.name: Cultural Foundation Abu Dhabi
backups.tips: Exhibitions and a library, next to Qasr Al Hosn.

backups.name: Meylas Al Muneera
backups.tips: Emirati breakfast and lunch; try balaleet (sweet vermicelli with omelette).

stops.name: Heritage Village
stops.tips: A recreated Bedouin village with craftspeople, next to Marina Mall. Free entry.

stops.name: Etihad Towers Observation Deck 300
stops.tips: On the 74th floor at 300 m, tea included, with views of Emirates Palace and the Corniche.

stops.name: Al Bateen Dhow Yard
stops.tips: Wooden dhows are still built by hand at Al Bateen harbour.

stops.name: Erth Restaurant
stops.tips: Michelin-starred modern Emirati cuisine, next to Qasr Al Hosn. Reservation required.

stops.name: Umm Al Emarat Park
stops.tips: A city park with a shaded greenhouse and a petting zoo.

backups.name: Al Bateen Beach
backups.tips: A quiet city beach; an alternative to the park.

days.theme: Souk morning and a gentle farewell

stops.name: World Trade Center Souk
stops.tips: Foster's modern take on the souk: spices, dates and oud for souvenirs.

stops.name: Al Hosn Coffee Break
stops.tips: Arabic coffee and dates for a farewell.

stops.name: Jubail Mangrove Park Boardwalk
stops.tips: A 2 km wooden boardwalk through the mangroves, on the road to Saadiyat and 20 minutes from the airport.

stops.name: Abu Dhabi Zayed International Airport
stops.tips: 30 minutes by taxi; farewell.

backups.name: Cafe Arabia Al Bateen
backups.tips: A villa café serving Arabic breakfast.

backups.name: Mushrif Central Park
backups.tips: A city park; an alternative to the mangroves.
